meta.title: Nevada DIDS Attorney Fee Billing Guidelines (2025-03-04)
meta.licence: No licence stated. Government/public-institution publication posted on the open web; used only as a public document for internal evaluation, not redistributed.
meta.pii_note: Public document from an agency or court; counts only, no matched text recorded. Hits: phone_us 1, street_address 1. Hits are agency contact details, addresses and generic role words, not private individuals.

pii_scan.disposition: Business and agency contact details only; no private-person data expected. Safe for local evaluation use.

rules.paraphrase: Time is billed in tenth-hour increments and anything else is rounded down to the nearest tenth.
Time or expenses split across indigent cases must name the other cases and be billed together; splitting with private clients is not allowed.
Travel claims need dates, routes and mileage; undocumented amounts may be reduced or denied.
Presumptive discovery review times: one minute per page plus one for annotating and one for organising, one minute per recording minute, one per redacted page.
Copies at fifteen cents black-and-white and twenty-five cents colour, supported by receipt.
Mileage beyond 50 miles outside the home city, lodging and per diem at government rates.
Research platforms, supplies, computer costs, fax/cell and local travel are not compensable.
A second attorney in a non-capital case needs county-plan compliance and advance DIDS approval.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Billing must be entered in LegalServer with supporting documentation.
Legal research is compensable except procedural-rule research.
